en: Colorized view of a spa complex with several connected white bath buildings and arched colonnades around salt lakes. Wooden piers and a pavilion sit over the water, with a large villa at left and a church spire on a hillside in the distance. Title printed in red at the top reads "Lacurile Horia, Cloșca și Crișan." The reverse states Romania and gives trilingual locality names, with the printer credited in Sibiu (Hermannstadt).
